notes: kb/Work PB5923 (re-adjudicated from CONFORMS, 2026-11-18). §1985:VI.3.3.4 GR1: "The program-name identifies the source program, the object program, and all listings pertaining to a particular program." The source program and the object program half holds: BinderDriver.MakeUnit reads the PROGRAM-ID program-name as the unit's Name, the emitted class and ExternalizedName carry it, ProgramEmitter.EmitModuleRegistrar and HostEntryEmitter.EmitEntry register it, and a CALL finds the program by it (the AS literal-1 phrase of 2002 is refused at --std 85, COBOL0900). The "all listings" half has nothing to identify: §1985:IV.7.1 requires an output listing and the compiler produces none (PB5923). PARTIAL until a listing carries the program-name.

next.reason: 1985: "The program-name identifies the source program, the object program, and all listings pertaining to a particular program."; 2023: "Literal-1, if specified, is the name of the program that is externalized to the operating environment.". 2023 adds literal-1, so the externalized (object) name can differ from program-name-1. It also drops the statement that program-name identifies the listings.
